div.head: Ps Cn for 10
div.ab: Sintque mediocrium et minutorum cause et earum correctiones tam criminalium quam ciuilium per prouidam sapientiam et rationem primariorum iudicate et decise; primariorum uero enormia, si que fuerint — ne scelus aliquod remaneat inultum —, nosmet in [curi]a nostra regali puniemus et a[nimaduer]temus.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 622 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: And let the cases of the middling and lesser men, and their correction, criminal as well as civil, be judged and decided by the provident wisdom and reason of the chief men; but the enormities of the chief men, if there are any (lest any crime remain unavenged), we ourselves shall punish in our royal [court] and [chastise].
